q: What carbon data do vehicle makers ask Pithampur auto component suppliers for?
title: Pithampur auto suppliers: carbon data
short: Expect Scope 1 and 2 totals with the 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh CEA grid factor, renewable electricity share and a figure per part. Build them from electricity and fuel bills, steel and aluminium purchases and an allocation by weight or machine hours, and keep one dataset for every customer template.
audience: Forging, machining, casting and sheet metal suppliers in Pithampur and Indore serving truck, tractor and car makers

ul: Share of solar or open access power.

p: Steel weight per part usually dominates. Use the mill figure if you have it, then add your allocated energy.
The location based factor is the national CEA figure. Open access solar lowers the market based figure only with documents showing the units delivered to you.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.
